Identité de Pascal: ${n \choose k} = {n-1 \choose k-1} + {n-1 \choose k}$

$$
\sum_{i = r}^{n + 1} {i \choose r} =  {n+1 \choose r} + \sum_{i = r}^{n} {i \choose r}  \stackrel{\text{ind}}{=} {n+1 \choose r} + {n+1 \choose r+1} \stackrel{\text{Pascal}}{=} {n+2 \choose r + 1}
$$
